high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the film "Wuthering Heights." The poster features two characters dressed in period costumes, suggesting a historical or romantic setting. The man has dark, curly hair and is wearing a dark coat with a white shirt underneath. The woman has light-colored hair styled in curls and is wearing a black dress with an off-the-shoulder neckline, adorned with a gold cross pendant. Her veil is flowing behind her, indicating movement or wind. The background is a muted, overcast sky, which adds to the dramatic and somewhat somber mood of the scene.
